body:
The checked display-output Plot exposes local frame/refusal Fore ports. Its constrained assignment must represent those boundaries without inventing network Lines.

Add explicitly opted-in schema 7 admission with exact resident Fore pins. Keep schemas 4–6 and the 125-byte envelope unchanged. Schema 7 endpoint records contain only local endpoint/cord ordinals, direction, front-port identity and an ABI digest. Legacy decoder entrances refuse schema 7; this profile refuses network bindings. Contiguous and borrowed entrances enforce finite counts, current Host/Boot, complete envelope and exact resident pins without allocation.

Validation: all nine assigned-plan tests pass in default and all-feature profiles; strict all-target Clippy, scoped formatting and diff checks pass. Negative cases cover altered/duplicate/missing Fore, invalid direction, changed ABI, foreign scope and network records.

Refs #6378. This is its decoder prerequisite: Make production, runtime preparation, native possession and physical output remain separate integration and the issue stays open.
title: Admit exact local Fore without inventing network Lines
